name: Water Breathing
description: (Tag:unique)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)You practice Water Breathing, a specialized swordsmanship style and breathing technique that mimics water's flow, flexibility, and adaptability through your movements, techniques, and abilities. Most, if not all, known techniques bend your body, arm, and weapon in fluid motion to match rushing or flowing water, and with magical power you manifest water to further augment the style.
